init.title: Settings
init.description: Choose the language of the weather warning texts. Dutch texts come straight from the KNMI app; English texts come from MeteoAlarm, the European warning service KNMI also publishes to. The warning level is always the KNMI level. The rain radar can show this integration's location as a small house.
